groups.activity: complete 3 missions for the Corpus on the node offering the part
groups.meta: arrives in your inbox when the invasion ends
conditions: Each part appears only when the game spawns an invasion that offers it; invasions are global, so nothing you do changes the timing.
Siding with the Grineer never pays these.
Switching sides mid-invasion resets your progress and forfeits both rewards.
A contested invasion can flip-flop for days, and the reward waits until it ends.
bonuses: The Warframe companion app lists invasions and their rewards.
The Wraith and Vandal pool is shared with Karak Wraith, Latron Wraith, Strun Wraith and Snipetron Vandal, so several can be live at once.

disclosures.title: working it
disclosures.body: Filter invasions by reward, not planet. Start the 3 missions as soon as you see a part; invasions can end within a day. Extra missions change nothing. The wiki lists each part at 2.76% on the Corpus side, rotation B.

disclosures.title: closing the last gap
disclosures.body: Every component is tradeable, so a missing Receiver is usually cheaper to buy than to wait for.

rows.label: Dera Vandal
rows.note: Barrel, Receiver and Stock; no other resources
